/* ---------------- generic forest chart ---------------- */
function niceLogTicks(lo,hi){var c=[0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,1,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5,1.6,1.8,2,2.5,3];return c.filter(function(v){return v>=lo&&v<=hi;});}
function niceLin(lo,hi,n){var span=hi-lo;var step=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(span/n)));var m=span/n/step;step*=m>=5?5:m>=2?2:1;var out=[];for(var v=Math.ceil(lo/step)*step;v<=hi+1e-9;v+=step)out.push(+v.toFixed(10));return out;}
function forest(container,rows,o){
  container.innerHTML='';var W=Math.max(300,container.clientWidth);var rowH=o.rowH||34,top=8,bottom=46;
  var svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:top+bottom+rows.length*rowH,'aria-label':o.aria||'chart'},container);
  var lw=0;rows.forEach(function(r){lw=Math.max(lw,textW(svg,r.label,'rowlab'));});
  var showVals=(o.values!==false)&&W>=600;var vw=0;if(showVals)rows.forEach(function(r){vw=Math.max(vw,textW(svg,r.valText,'vallab'));});
  var L=lw+16,R=showVals?vw+20:18,pw=W-L-R;
  var vals=[o.ref];rows.forEach(function(r){vals.push(r.est);if(r.lo!=null)vals.push(r.lo);if(r.hi!=null)vals.push(r.hi);});
  var mn=Math.min.apply(null,vals),mx=Math.max.apply(null,vals);if(o.domain){mn=Math.min(mn,o.domain[0]);mx=Math.max(mx,o.domain[1]);}
  var X;if(o.log){var a=Math.log(mn*0.95),b=Math.log(mx*1.05);X=function(v){return L+(Math.log(v)-a)/(b-a)*pw;};}else{var pad=(mx-mn)*0.06;var a2=mn-pad,b2=mx+pad;X=function(v){return L+(v-a2)/(b2-a2)*pw;};mn=a2;mx=b2;}
  var ticks=o.log?niceLogTicks(mn*0.95,mx*1.05):niceLin(mn,mx,Math.max(3,Math.floor(pw/70)));
  var g=el('g',{'class':'ax'},svg);var yb=top+rows.length*rowH;var last=-1e9;
  ticks.forEach(function(v){var x=X(v);if(x<L-1||x>L+pw+1)return;el('line',{x1:x,x2:x,y1:top,y2:yb,stroke:'#eceef1'},g);var s=o.tickFmt?o.tickFmt(v):String(v);var w=textW(svg,s,'tick');if(x-w/2<last+8)return;tx(g,x,yb+16,s,{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'tick'});last=x+w/2;});
  el('line',{x1:X(o.ref),x2:X(o.ref),y1:top-2,y2:yb,stroke:'#1b1f24','stroke-dasharray':'4 3','stroke-width':1.3},svg);
  tx(svg,L+pw/2,yb+38,o.xTitle,{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'axtitle'});
  rows.forEach(function(r,i){var y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2;
    tx(svg,L-10,y+5,r.label,{'text-anchor':'end','class':'rowlab',fill:r.dim?'#8a939c':null});
    var gm=el('g',{},svg);
    if(r.lo!=null)el('line',{x1:X(r.lo),x2:X(r.hi),y1:y,y2:y,stroke:r.color,'stroke-width':2.4},gm);
    if(r.shape==='diamond'){var x=X(r.est);el('path',{d:'M'+x+' '+(y-7)+'L'+(x+7)+' '+y+'L'+x+' '+(y+7)+'L'+(x-7)+' '+y+'Z',fill:r.hollow?'#fff':r.color,stroke:r.color,'stroke-width':2,'class':'hl'},gm);}
    else el('circle',{cx:X(r.est),cy:y,r:6.5,fill:r.hollow?'#fff':r.color,stroke:r.color,'stroke-width':2,'class':'hl'},gm);
    el('rect',{x:L,y:y-rowH/2,width:pw,height:rowH,fill:'transparent'},gm);
    bindTip(gm,function(){return r.tip;},r.label+': '+r.valText);
    if(showVals)tx(svg,W-R+12,y+5,r.valText,{'class':'vallab',fill:r.dim?'#8a939c':'#1b1f24'});
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------------- generic vertical bar chart ---------------- */
function bars(container,cats,o){
  container.innerHTML='';var W=Math.max(280,container.clientWidth),Hh=o.height||280;
  var svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:Hh,'aria-label':o.aria},container);
  var ymax=o.ymax;var ticks=niceLin(0,ymax,5);ymax=Math.max(ymax,ticks[ticks.length-1]);
  var tw=0;ticks.forEach(function(v){tw=Math.max(tw,textW(svg,o.yFmt(v),'tick'));});
  var L=tw+14,R=10,T=30,B=o.xTitle?52:34,pw=W-L-R,ph=Hh-T-B;
  var Y=function(v){return T+ph-(v/ymax)*ph;};
  tx(svg,L-tw-6<0?2:2,16,o.yTitle,{'class':'axtitle'});
  var g=el('g',{'class':'ax'},svg);
  ticks.forEach(function(v){el('line',{x1:L,x2:L+pw,y1:Y(v),y2:Y(v),stroke:v===0?'#8a939c':'#eceef1'},g);tx(g,L-6,Y(v)+4,o.yFmt(v),{'text-anchor':'end','class':'tick'});});
  var bw=pw/cats.length;
  cats.forEach(function(c,i){var x0=L+i*bw;tx(g,x0+bw/2,T+ph+18,c.label,{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'tick'});
    var gm=el('g',{},svg);var inner=bw*0.56;var bx=x0+(bw-inner)/2;
    var bh=Math.max(0,Y(0)-Y(c.value));el('rect',{x:bx,y:Y(c.value),width:inner,height:bh,fill:c.color||'var(--accent)','class':'hl',rx:2},gm);
    (c.markers||[]).forEach(function(m){var mx=bx+inner/2+(m.dx||0)*inner*0.28,my=Y(m.value);if(m.shape==='diamond')el('path',{d:'M'+mx+' '+(my-7)+'L'+(mx+7)+' '+my+'L'+mx+' '+(my+7)+'L'+(mx-7)+' '+my+'Z',fill:m.color,stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.5},gm);else el('circle',{cx:mx,cy:my,r:6,fill:m.color,stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.5},gm);});
    el('rect',{x:x0,y:T,width:bw,height:ph,fill:'transparent'},gm);
    bindTip(gm,function(){return c.tip;},c.aria);});
  if(o.xTitle)tx(svg,L+pw/2,Hh-8,o.xTitle,{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'axtitle'});
  return svg;
}

/* ================= HEADLINE ================= */
var FOLDS=['Screen','Held-out','MeSH'];
(function(){
  var mesh=H.rows.filter(function(r){return r.fold==='MeSH'&&r.spec==='coprimary'&&r.var==='A';})[0];
  document.getElementById('big-n').textContent='+'+Math.round((mesh.irr-1)*100)+'%';
  document.getElementById('big-u').textContent='newcomer uptake per SD of host share on MeSH (IRR '+f2(mesh.irr)+', 95% CI '+f2(mesh.lo)+' to '+f2(mesh.hi)+'; verdict '+H.verdict.mesh+')';
})();
function drawHeadline(){
  var spec=document.querySelector('input[name=spec]:checked').value, showCT=document.getElementById('show-ct').checked;
  var rows=[];
  ['Screen','Held-out','MeSH','Pooled (IVW)'].forEach(function(f){
    H.rows.filter(function(r){return r.fold===f&&r.spec===spec;}).forEach(function(r){
      if(r.var==='CT'&&!showCT)return;
      var isA=r.var==='A';var lab=f+(isA?'':' · co-transfer');
      var vt=f2(r.irr)+(r.lo!=null?' ['+f2(r.lo)+', '+f2(r.hi)+']':'')+(r.p!=null?'  '+pStr(r.p):'');
      var tipH='<b>'+esc(f)+(isA?' · host-vocabulary share':' · co-transfer')+'</b><br>'+(spec==='coprimary'?'Co-primary (concept, entry-year and host FE)':'Primary (concept×year and host×year FE)')+'<br>IRR per SD '+f2(r.irr)+(r.lo!=null?', 95% CI '+f2(r.lo)+' to '+f2(r.hi):'')+(r.p!=null?'<br>'+esc(pStr(r.p)):'')+(r.N?'<br>N = '+fmtInt(r.N)+' events, G = '+r.G+' concept clusters':'')+(r.I2!=null?'<br>Inverse-variance weighted pooled estimate, I² = '+r.I2:'')+'<br><span class="muted">'+esc(r.src)+'</span>';
      var sig=r.lo!=null&&(r.lo>1||r.hi<1);
      rows.push({label:lab,est:r.irr,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:isA?(f==='Pooled (IVW)'?'#0f3d70':'var(--accent)'):'#8a939c',shape:isA&&f!=='Pooled (IVW)'?'circle':'diamond',hollow:isA&&!sig,dim:!isA,valText:vt,tip:tipH});
    });
  });
  forest(document.getElementById('c-headline'),rows,{log:true,ref:1,xTitle:'Incidence-rate ratio per SD (log scale)',aria:'Forest plot of incidence-rate ratios by fold',domain:[0.6,1.7]});
  var t=document.getElementById('t-headline');
  function row(f,v){return H.rows.filter(function(r){return r.fold===f&&r.spec===spec&&r.var===v;})[0];}
  if(spec==='coprimary'){var s=row('Screen','A'),h=row('Held-out','A'),m=row('MeSH','A'),p=row('Pooled (IVW)','A');
    t.textContent='Under the co-primary model every fold clears IRR = 1: Screen '+f2(s.irr)+', Held-out '+f2(h.irr)+' ['+f2(h.lo)+', '+f2(h.hi)+'], MeSH '+f2(m.irr)+' ['+f2(m.lo)+', '+f2(m.hi)+'], pooled '+f2(p.irr)+'.'+(showCT?' Co-transfer intervals all include 1.':'');}
  else{var h2=row('Held-out','A'),m2=row('MeSH','A');
    t.textContent='The strict model keeps only '+h2.N+' Held-out events in '+h2.G+' clusters and is inconclusive there (IRR '+f2(h2.irr)+' ['+f2(h2.lo)+', '+f2(h2.hi)+']), while MeSH, with '+fmtInt(m2.N)+' events, still gives '+f2(m2.irr)+' ['+f2(m2.lo)+', '+f2(m2.hi)+'].';}
}
Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name=spec]'),function(i){i.addEventListener('change',drawHeadline);});
document.getElementById('show-ct').addEventListener('change',drawHeadline);

/* ================= EVENTS ================= */
var C=EV.cols.reduce(function(a,k,i){a[k]=i;return a;},{});
var events=EV.events.map(function(r,i){return {i:i,fold:r[C.fold],concept:EV.concepts[r[C.concept]],host:EV.subfields[r[C.host]],origin:EV.subfields[r[C.origin]],e:r[C.e],A:r[C.A_cont],CT:r[C.CT],Y:r[C.Y],rooted:r[C.rooted],p0:r[C.pred_base],p1:r[C.pred_method],np:r[C.n_partners],ne:r[C.n_entry_papers],fg:r[C.field_group],yy:r[C.Y_by_year]};});
document.getElementById('n-events-all').textContent=fmtInt(events.length);
var byFold=[0,1,2].map(function(f){return events.filter(function(e){return e.fold===f;});});
function pct(arr,v){var n=0;arr.forEach(function(e){if(e.A<v)n++;});return Math.round(100*n/arr.length);}
function mean(a,f){var s=0;a.forEach(function(x){s+=f(x);});return a.length?s/a.length:NaN;}

/* ---- bins ---- */
function drawBins(){
  var f=+document.getElementById('bins-fold').value,metric=document.querySelector('input[name=binmetric]:checked').value;
  var arr=byFold[f].slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.A-b.A;});var n=arr.length,cats=[],groups=[];
  for(var q=0;q<5;q++){var g=arr.slice(Math.floor(q*n/5),Math.floor((q+1)*n/5));groups.push(g);}
  var ymax=0;
  groups.forEach(function(g,q){var obs=metric==='mean'?mean(g,function(e){return e.Y;}):100*mean(g,function(e){return e.Y>0?1:0;});
    var b0=mean(g,function(e){return e.p0;}),b1=mean(g,function(e){return e.p1;});
    var lo=g[0].A,hi=g[g.length-1].A;
    var mk=metric==='mean'?[{value:b0,color:'#6b7680',shape:'diamond',dx:-1},{value:b1,color:'var(--orange)',dx:1}]:[];
    ymax=Math.max(ymax,obs,metric==='mean'?Math.max(b0,b1):0);
    var tipH='<b>Q'+(q+1)+' of '+FOLDS[f]+'</b> (n = '+g.length+')<br>Host share '+f3(lo)+' to '+f3(hi)+'<br>'+(metric==='mean'?'Observed mean newcomer papers '+obs.toFixed(2)+'<br>Baseline prediction '+b0.toFixed(2)+'<br>With host share '+b1.toFixed(2):'Share with any newcomer paper '+obs.toFixed(1)+'%');
    cats.push({label:'Q'+(q+1),value:obs,markers:mk,tip:tipH,aria:'Q'+(q+1)+', host share '+f3(lo)+' to '+f3(hi)+': '+(metric==='mean'?obs.toFixed(2)+' newcomer papers':obs.toFixed(1)+' percent with uptake')});
    groups[q].obs=obs;});
  document.getElementById('bins-legend').innerHTML='<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Observed</span>'+(metric==='mean'?'<span><i class="sw" style="background:#6b7680;transform:rotate(45deg);width:11px;height:11px"></i>Baseline prediction (controls only)</span><span><i class="sw dot" style="background:var(--orange)"></i>Prediction with host share</span>':'');
  bars(document.getElementById('c-bins'),cats,{ymax:ymax*1.08,yTitle:metric==='mean'?'Newcomer papers per event (5 years)':'Events with any newcomer paper (%)',yFmt:function(v){return metric==='mean'?String(+v.toFixed(1)):v.toFixed(0);},xTitle:'Host-vocabulary share, fifths (Q1 lowest)',aria:'Bar chart of uptake by host-share fifth'});
  var a=groups[0].obs,b=groups[4].obs;
  document.getElementById('t-bins').textContent=metric==='mean'?('In the '+FOLDS[f]+' events, the top fifth by host share draws '+b.toFixed(2)+' newcomer papers on average against '+a.toFixed(2)+' in the bottom fifth; this raw gap still contains concept and field differences.'):('In the '+FOLDS[f]+' events, '+b.toFixed(1)+'% of top-fifth entries attract at least one newcomer paper, against '+a.toFixed(1)+'% of bottom-fifth entries.');
}
document.getElementById('bins-fold').addEventListener('change',drawBins);
Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name=binmetric]'),function(i){i.addEventListener('change',drawBins);});

/* ---- browser ---- */
var brState={shown:25,sel:null};
function outcomeClass(e){return e.rooted?'rooted':e.Y>0?'some':'none';}
function outcomeText(e){return e.rooted?'rooted':e.Y>0?'some uptake':'no uptake';}
function filtered(){var f=document.getElementById('br-fold').value,o=document.getElementById('br-out').value,q=document.getElementById('br-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(),s=document.getElementById('br-sort').value;
  var a=events.filter(function(e){return (f==='all'||e.fold===+f)&&(o==='all'||outcomeClass(e)===o)&&(!q||e.concept.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0||e.host.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0);});
  var key={share:function(e){return -e.A;},y:function(e){return -e.Y;},gain:function(e){return -(Math.abs(e.Y-e.p0)-Math.abs(e.Y-e.p1));},loss:function(e){return (Math.abs(e.Y-e.p0)-Math.abs(e.Y-e.p1));},year:function(e){return e.e;}}[s];
  a.sort(function(x,y){return key(x)-key(y)||x.i-y.i;});return a;}
function drawBrowser(keepSel){var a=filtered();var list=document.getElementById('br-list');list.innerHTML='';
  var fsel=document.getElementById('br-fold').value;
  document.getElementById('br-count').textContent='Showing '+Math.min(brState.shown,a.length)+' of '+fmtInt(a.length)+' matching events ('+fmtInt(events.length)+' in all).';
  a.slice(0,brState.shown).forEach(function(e){var li=document.createElement('li');var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',brState.sel===e.i?'true':'false');
    b.innerHTML='<span class="c">'+esc(e.concept)+'</span><span class="v">share '+f3(e.A)+'</span><span class="h">→ '+esc(e.host)+', '+e.e+(fsel==='all'?' · '+FOLDS[e.fold]:'')+'</span><span class="v"><span class="pill '+outcomeClass(e)+'">'+e.Y+' new</span></span>';
    b.setAttribute('aria-label',e.concept+' into '+e.host+', '+e.e+', host share '+f3(e.A)+', '+e.Y+' newcomer papers, '+outcomeText(e));
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){brState.sel=e.i;Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.querySelectorAll('button'),function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');});b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');drawDetail(e);});
    li.appendChild(b);list.appendChild(li);});
  document.getElementById('br-more').hidden=a.length<=brState.shown;
  if(!keepSel||brState.sel===null||!a.some(function(e){return e.i===brState.sel;})){if(a.length){brState.sel=a[0].i;var fb=list.querySelector('button');if(fb)fb.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');drawDetail(a[0]);}else{document.getElementById('br-detail').innerHTML='<p class="muted">No event matches these filters.</p>';document.getElementById('t-browser').textContent='No event matches the current filters.';}}
  else drawDetail(events[brState.sel]);}
function drawDetail(e){var d=document.getElementById('br-detail');var fold=byFold[e.fold];
  var z=(e.A-mean(fold,function(x){return x.A;}));
  d.innerHTML='<h4>'+esc(cap(e.concept))+' → '+esc(e.host)+', '+e.e+'</h4><p class="small muted" style="margin:0 0 10px">'+FOLDS[e.fold]+' fold · origin subfield: '+esc(e.origin)+'</p>'+
  '<div class="cols3"><div><h4>Input at entry</h4><dl class="kv"><div><dt>Entry papers</dt><dd>'+e.ne+'</dd></div><div><dt>Distinct partners</dt><dd>'+e.np+'</dd></div><div><dt>Host share</dt><dd>'+f3(e.A)+'</dd></div><div><dt>Fold percentile</dt><dd>'+pct(fold,e.A)+'</dd></div><div><dt>Co-transfer</dt><dd>'+e.CT.toFixed(2)+'</dd></div></dl></div>'+
  '<div><h4>What happened</h4><dl class="kv"><div><dt>Newcomer papers</dt><dd>'+e.Y+'</dd></div><div><dt>Verdict</dt><dd><span class="pill '+outcomeClass(e)+'">'+outcomeText(e)+'</span></dd></div></dl><div class="chart" id="d-years"></div></div>'+
  '<div><h4>Predictions</h4><div class="chart" id="d-pred"></div></div></div>';
  if(e.yy){var yv=e.yy;var ymx=Math.max(1,Math.max.apply(null,yv));bars(document.getElementById('d-years'),yv.map(function(v,k){return {label:String(e.e+k+1).slice(2),value:v,tip:'<b>'+(e.e+k+1)+'</b><br>'+v+' newcomer papers',aria:(e.e+k+1)+': '+v+' newcomer papers'};}),{ymax:ymx,height:150,yTitle:'Papers per year',yFmt:function(v){return String(v);},aria:'Newcomer papers by year'});}
  var pm=Math.max(e.Y,e.p0,e.p1,1);
  bars(document.getElementById('d-pred'),[{label:'Base',value:e.p0,color:'#8a939c',tip:'<b>Baseline</b> (controls only)<br>'+e.p0.toFixed(2)+' predicted newcomer papers',aria:'Baseline prediction '+e.p0.toFixed(2)},{label:'+Share',value:e.p1,color:'var(--orange)',tip:'<b>With host share and co-transfer</b><br>'+e.p1.toFixed(2)+' predicted newcomer papers',aria:'Prediction with host share '+e.p1.toFixed(2)},{label:'Actual',value:e.Y,color:'var(--accent)',tip:'<b>Observed</b><br>'+e.Y+' newcomer papers',aria:'Observed '+e.Y}],{ymax:pm*1.05,height:170,yTitle:'Newcomer papers',yFmt:function(v){return String(+v.toFixed(1));},aria:'Baseline, method and observed newcomer papers'});
  var closer=Math.abs(e.Y-e.p1)<Math.abs(e.Y-e.p0);
  document.getElementById('t-browser').textContent='For '+e.concept+' entering '+e.host+' in '+e.e+', adding host share and co-transfer moved the prediction from '+e.p0.toFixed(2)+' to '+e.p1.toFixed(2)+' newcomer papers; '+e.Y+' were observed, so the model with host share was '+(closer?'closer':'further away')+'.';}
['br-fold','br-out','br-sort'].forEach(function(id){document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change',function(){brState.shown=25;drawBrowser(false);});});
document.getElementById('br-q').addEventListener('input',function(){brState.shown=25;drawBrowser(false);});
document.getElementById('br-more').addEventListener('click',function(){brState.shown+=25;drawBrowser(true);});

/* ---- cases ---- */
var caseNames=[];CASES.entries.forEach(function(c){if(caseNames.indexOf(c.concept)<0)caseNames.push(c.concept);});
var caseIdx=0;var tabsEl=document.getElementById('case-tabs');
caseNames.forEach(function(n,i){var b=document.createElement('button');b.setAttribute('role','tab');b.id='case-tab-'+i;b.setAttribute('aria-controls','c-cases');b.textContent=n;b.addEventListener('click',function(){selCase(i);});tabsEl.appendChild(b);});
function tabKeys(container,onSel){container.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){var tabs=Array.prototype.slice.call(container.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]'));var i=tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);if(i<0)return;var j=null;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')j=(i+1)%tabs.length;else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')j=(i-1+tabs.length)%tabs.length;else if(e.key==='Home')j=0;else if(e.key==='End')j=tabs.length-1;if(j!==null){e.preventDefault();tabs[j].focus();onSel(j);}});}
tabKeys(tabsEl,function(j){selCase(j);});
function selCase(i){caseIdx=i;Array.prototype.forEach.call(tabsEl.children,function(b,k){b.setAttribute('aria-selected',k===i?'true':'false');b.tabIndex=k===i?0:-1;});document.getElementById('c-cases').setAttribute('aria-labelledby','case-tab-'+i);drawCases();}
function drawCases(){var name=caseNames[caseIdx],meta=CASES.meta[name];var es=CASES.entries.filter(function(c){return c.concept===name;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.A_cont-a.A_cont;});
  var box=document.getElementById('c-cases');box.innerHTML='';var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth),rowH=26,T=6,B=44;
  var svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:T+B+es.length*rowH,'aria-label':'Host entries of '+name+' sorted by host share'},box);
  var labs=es.map(function(c){return c.host+' '+c.e;});var lw=0;labs.forEach(function(s){lw=Math.max(lw,textW(svg,s,'rowlab'));});
  var small=W<520;if(small){labs=es.map(function(c){var h=c.host.length>22?c.host.slice(0,21)+'…':c.host;return h+' '+String(c.e).slice(2);});lw=0;labs.forEach(function(s){lw=Math.max(lw,textW(svg,s,'rowlab'));});}
  var L=lw+14,R=62,pw=W-L-R;var xmax=Math.max(0.15,es[0].A_cont*1.1);var X=function(v){return L+v/xmax*pw;};
  var ticks=niceLin(0,xmax,Math.max(3,Math.floor(pw/80)));var g=el('g',{'class':'ax'},svg);var yb=T+es.length*rowH;
  ticks.forEach(function(v){if(v>xmax)return;el('line',{x1:X(v),x2:X(v),y1:T,y2:yb,stroke:'#eceef1'},g);tx(g,X(v),yb+16,v.toFixed(2),{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'tick'});});
  tx(svg,L+pw/2,yb+38,'Host-vocabulary share (fraction)',{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'axtitle'});
  var non=es.filter(function(c){return !c.rooted;});var nm=non.length?mean(non,function(c){return c.A_cont;}):null;
  es.forEach(function(c,i){var y=T+i*rowH;tx(svg,L-8,y+rowH/2+5,labs[i],{'text-anchor':'end','class':'rowlab'});var gm=el('g',{},svg);
    el('rect',{x:L,y:y+4,width:Math.max(1,X(c.A_cont)-L),height:rowH-8,fill:c.rooted?'var(--green)':'#b8bfc7',rx:2,'class':'hl'},gm);
    tx(svg,X(c.A_cont)+6,y+rowH/2+5,f3(c.A_cont),{'class':'vallab'});
    el('rect',{x:L,y:y,width:pw,height:rowH,fill:'transparent'},gm);
    bindTip(gm,function(){return '<b>'+esc(c.host)+', '+c.e+'</b><br>Host share '+f3(c.A_cont)+'<br>Co-transfer '+c.CT.toFixed(2)+'<br>Distinct partners '+c.n_partners+'<br>Newcomer papers '+c.Y+'<br>'+(c.rooted?'Rooted':'Not rooted');},c.host+' '+c.e+', host share '+f3(c.A_cont)+', '+(c.rooted?'rooted':'not rooted')+', '+c.Y+' newcomer papers');});
  el('line',{x1:X(0),x2:X(0),y1:T,y2:yb,stroke:'#8a939c'},svg);
  if(nm!==null)el('line',{x1:X(nm),x2:X(nm),y1:T,y2:yb,stroke:'#1b1f24','stroke-dasharray':'4 3','stroke-width':1.4},svg);
  var root=es.filter(function(c){return c.rooted;});var t;
  var head=cap(name)+' ('+meta.cluster.split(' (')[0]+', origin '+meta.origin_subfield+', first used '+meta.F+'): '+es.length+' co-primary '+(es.length===1?'entry':'entries')+', '+root.length+' rooted. ';
  if(root.length&&non.length){var above=non.every(function(c){return c.A_cont<root[0].A_cont;});t=head+'The rooted entry ('+root[0].host+', '+root[0].e+') has host share '+f3(root[0].A_cont)+' against a non-rooted mean of '+f3(nm)+(above?', higher than every non-rooted entry.':'.');}
  else if(root.length){t=head+'Its single entry took root with host share '+f3(root[0].A_cont)+', so there is no within-concept contrast.';}
  else{var mx=non[0];t=head+'None took root (mean share '+f3(nm)+'). The highest-share entry, '+mx.host+' at '+f3(mx.A_cont)+', did not take root either: host vocabulary is a gradient, not a guarantee.';}
  document.getElementById('t-cases').textContent=t;}

/* ---- margins ---- */
function drawMargins(){var m=document.querySelector('input[name=margin]:checked').value;var rows=[];
  var test=m==='ext'?'K1a_LPM':'K1b',ivwT=m==='ext'?'K1f_IVW_K1a_LPM_pp_per_sd':'K1f_IVW_K1b_log_irr_per_sd';var fmt=m==='ext'?f2:f3;
  [['SCREEN','Screen'],['HELDOUT','Held-out'],['MESH','MeSH'],['IVW','Pooled (IVW)']].forEach(function(fp_){var r=MAR.filter(function(x){return x.test===(fp_[0]==='IVW'?ivwT:test)&&x.fold===fp_[0];})[0];
    var vt=fmt(r.est)+' ['+fmt(r.lo)+', '+fmt(r.hi)+']';
    rows.push({label:fp_[1],est:r.est,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:fp_[0]==='IVW'?'#0f3d70':'var(--accent)',shape:fp_[0]==='IVW'?'diamond':'circle',valText:vt,tip:'<b>'+fp_[1]+'</b><br>'+(m==='ext'?'Linear probability model: change in P(any newcomer paper) per SD, percentage points':'PPML on events with at least one newcomer paper, IRR per SD')+'<br>'+vt+(r.p!=null?'<br>'+esc(pStr(r.p))+' (CRV1)':'')+(r.N?'<br>N = '+fmtInt(r.N)+', G = '+r.G:'')+(r.base!=null?'<br>Base rate '+(100*r.base).toFixed(0)+'%':'')});});
  forest(document.getElementById('c-margins'),rows,m==='ext'?{ref:0,xTitle:'Percentage points per SD of host share',aria:'Extensive margin estimates',tickFmt:function(v){return String(v);}}:{log:true,ref:1,xTitle:'IRR per SD, given uptake started (log scale)',aria:'Intensive margin estimates'});
  var ivw=MAR.filter(function(x){return x.test===ivwT;})[0],sh=MAR.filter(function(x){return x.test==='K1f_IVW_ext_share';})[0],scr=MAR.filter(function(x){return x.test==='K1a_LPM'&&x.fold==='SCREEN';})[0];
  document.getElementById('t-margins').textContent=m==='ext'?('One SD more host share raises the chance that any newcomer paper appears by '+f2(ivw.est)+' percentage points (pooled 95% CI '+f2(ivw.lo)+' to '+f2(ivw.hi)+'), about '+Math.round(ivw.est/(100*scr.base)*100)+'% of the '+Math.round(100*scr.base)+'% base rate. The extensive margin carries '+f2(sh.est)+' of the total effect (95% CI '+f2(sh.lo)+' to '+f2(sh.hi)+').'):('Once uptake has started, one SD more host share multiplies the count of newcomer papers by '+f3(ivw.est)+' (pooled 95% CI '+f3(ivw.lo)+' to '+f3(ivw.hi)+'); every fold interval excludes 1. The intensive margin carries the remaining share of the effect.');}
Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name=margin]'),function(i){i.addEventListener('change',drawMargins);});

/* ================= TRY IT ================= */
function rateSplit(arr,t,out){var a=[],b=[];arr.forEach(function(e){(e.A>=t?a:b).push(e);});var f=out==='any'?function(e){return e.Y>0?1:0;}:function(e){return e.rooted;};return {na:a.length,nb:b.length,ra:a.length?100*mean(a,f):NaN,rb:b.length?100*mean(b,f):NaN,ma:mean(a,function(e){return e.Y;}),mb:mean(b,function(e){return e.Y;})};}
function drawTry(){var t=+document.getElementById('thr').value,f=+document.getElementById('try-fold').value,out=document.querySelector('input[name=tryout]:checked').value;
  document.getElementById('thr-out').textContent=t.toFixed(3);
  var s=rateSplit(byFold[f],t,out);var lab=out==='any'?'with any newcomer paper':'rooted';
  var ymax=Math.max(10,(isNaN(s.ra)?0:s.ra),(isNaN(s.rb)?0:s.rb))*1.12;
  bars(document.getElementById('c-try'),[{label:'Below',value:isNaN(s.rb)?0:s.rb,color:'#8a939c',tip:'<b>Share below '+t.toFixed(3)+'</b><br>'+s.nb+' events<br>'+(isNaN(s.rb)?'no events':s.rb.toFixed(1)+'% '+lab)+'<br>Mean newcomer papers '+(isNaN(s.mb)?'n/a':s.mb.toFixed(2)),aria:'Below threshold: '+s.nb+' events, '+(isNaN(s.rb)?'none':s.rb.toFixed(1)+' percent '+lab)},{label:'At or above',value:isNaN(s.ra)?0:s.ra,color:'var(--accent)',tip:'<b>Share at or above '+t.toFixed(3)+'</b><br>'+s.na+' events<br>'+(isNaN(s.ra)?'no events':s.ra.toFixed(1)+'% '+lab)+'<br>Mean newcomer papers '+(isNaN(s.ma)?'n/a':s.ma.toFixed(2)),aria:'At or above threshold: '+s.na+' events, '+(isNaN(s.ra)?'none':s.ra.toFixed(1)+' percent '+lab)}],{ymax:ymax,height:280,yTitle:'Events '+lab+' (%)',yFmt:function(v){return v.toFixed(0);},xTitle:'Host share vs threshold',aria:'Outcome rate below and above the threshold'});
  // sweep
  var pts=[];for(var x=0.005;x<=0.2001;x+=0.005){var r=rateSplit(byFold[f],x,out);if(r.na>=30&&r.nb>=30)pts.push([x,r.ra-r.rb]);}
  var box=document.getElementById('c-sweep');box.innerHTML='';var W=Math.max(280,box.clientWidth),Hh=280;var svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:Hh,'aria-label':'Gap between groups across thresholds'},box);
  var ys=pts.map(function(p){return p[1];});var lo=Math.min(0,Math.min.apply(null,ys)),hi=Math.max(0,Math.max.apply(null,ys));var tk=niceLin(lo,hi,5);lo=Math.min(lo,tk[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,tk[tk.length-1]);
  var tw=0;tk.forEach(function(v){tw=Math.max(tw,textW(svg,String(v),'tick'));});var L=tw+14,R=12,T=30,B=52,pw=W-L-R,ph=Hh-T-B;
  var X=function(v){return L+(v-0)/(0.2)*pw;},Y=function(v){return T+ph-(v-lo)/(hi-lo||1)*ph;};
  tx(svg,2,16,'Gap: above minus below (percentage points)',{'class':'axtitle'});
  var g=el('g',{'class':'ax'},svg);tk.forEach(function(v){el('line',{x1:L,x2:L+pw,y1:Y(v),y2:Y(v),stroke:v===0?'#1b1f24':'#eceef1','stroke-dasharray':v===0?'4 3':null},g);tx(g,L-6,Y(v)+4,String(v),{'text-anchor':'end','class':'tick'});});
  [0,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2].forEach(function(v){tx(g,X(v),T+ph+18,v.toFixed(2),{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'tick'});});
  tx(svg,L+pw/2,Hh-8,'Host-share threshold',{'text-anchor':'middle','class':'axtitle'});
  if(pts.length)el('path',{d:pts.map(function(p,i){return (i?'L':'M')+X(p[0])+' '+Y(p[1]);}).join(''),fill:'none',stroke:'var(--accent)','stroke-width':2.2},svg);
  var cur=s.na>=30&&s.nb>=30?s.ra-s.rb:null;
  el('line',{x1:X(t),x2:X(t),y1:T,y2:T+ph,stroke:'var(--orange)','stroke-width':1.5},svg);
  if(cur!==null){var gm=el('g',{},svg);el('circle',{cx:X(t),cy:Y(cur),r:6,fill:'var(--orange)',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.5,'class':'hl'},gm);bindTip(gm,function(){return '<b>Threshold '+t.toFixed(3)+'</b><br>Gap '+sgn(cur,1)+' percentage points<br>'+s.na+' events above, '+s.nb+' below';},'Current threshold gap '+sgn(cur,1)+' percentage points');}
  var tt_=document.getElementById('t-try');
  if(s.na<30||s.nb<30)tt_.textContent='At '+t.toFixed(3)+' one side holds fewer than 30 '+FOLDS[f]+' events ('+s.na+' above, '+s.nb+' below), too few for a stable rate; the sweep line leaves such thresholds out.';
  else tt_.textContent='At a threshold of '+t.toFixed(3)+', '+s.ra.toFixed(1)+'% of the '+s.na+' host-leaning '+FOLDS[f]+' entries are '+lab+', against '+s.rb.toFixed(1)+'% of the other '+s.nb+' ('+sgn(s.ra-s.rb,1)+' points). '+(s.ra>s.rb?'The raw gap points the same way as the regression.':'Here the raw gap runs against the regression, a reminder that this comparison has no fixed effects.');}
document.getElementById('thr').addEventListener('input',drawTry);document.getElementById('try-fold').addEventListener('change',drawTry);
Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name=tryout]'),function(i){i.addEventListener('change',drawTry);});

/* ================= FAILS ================= */
var failK='ladder',ladderFold='HELDOUT';
var failTabs=document.getElementById('fail-tabs');
Array.prototype.forEach.call(failTabs.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]'),function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){selFail(b.getAttribute('data-k'));});});
tabKeys(failTabs,function(j){selFail(failTabs.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')[j].getAttribute('data-k'));});
function selFail(k){failK=k;Array.prototype.forEach.call(failTabs.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]'),function(b){var on=b.getAttribute('data-k')===k;b.setAttribute('aria-selected',on?'true':'false');b.tabIndex=on?0:-1;if(on)document.getElementById('c-fail').setAttribute('aria-labelledby',b.id);});
  var sub=document.getElementById('fail-sub');sub.innerHTML='';
  if(k==='ladder'){sub.innerHTML='<div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Fold">'+[['SCREEN','Screen'],['HELDOUT','Held-out'],['MESH','MeSH']].map(function(f){return '<label><input type="radio" name="ladfold" value="'+f[0]+'"'+(f[0]===ladderFold?' checked':'')+'><span>'+f[1]+'</span></label>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sub.querySelectorAll('input'),function(i){i.addEventListener('change',function(){ladderFold=i.value;drawFail();});});}
  drawFail();}
function drawFail(){var q=document.getElementById('fail-q'),t=document.getElementById('t-fail'),box=document.getElementById('c-fail');
  if(failK==='ladder'){q.textContent='Does the effect survive when "uptake" means more than one newcomer paper?';
    var names={Any:'At least 1 paper',Y_ge3:'At least 3 papers',Y_ge5:'At least 5 papers',EST_bin:'Rooted (establishment)'};
    var rs=MAR.filter(function(x){return x.test==='K1d_ladder'&&x.fold===ladderFold;});
    var rows=rs.map(function(r){var sig=r.lo>0;var vt=f2(r.est)+' ['+f2(r.lo)+', '+f2(r.hi)+']  '+pStr(r.p);return {label:names[r.outcome],est:r.est,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:sig?'var(--accent)':'#8a939c',hollow:!sig,valText:vt,tip:'<b>'+names[r.outcome]+'</b><br>Linear probability model, co-primary FE<br>'+vt+' (pp per SD)<br>N = '+fmtInt(r.N)+', G = '+r.G+'<br>Base rate '+(100*r.base).toFixed(0)+'%'};});
    forest(box,rows,{ref:0,xTitle:'Percentage points per SD of host share',aria:'Threshold ladder',tickFmt:function(v){return String(v);}});
    var est=rs.filter(function(r){return r.outcome==='EST_bin';})[0],any=rs.filter(function(r){return r.outcome==='Any';})[0];var fl={SCREEN:'Screen',HELDOUT:'Held-out',MESH:'MeSH'}[ladderFold];
    t.textContent=est.lo>0?(fl+': the effect holds at every threshold, from '+f2(any.est)+' points for any uptake to '+f2(est.est)+' for establishment.'):(fl+': clear at one paper ('+f2(any.est)+' points, '+pStr(any.p)+'), but the binary establishment row is null ('+f2(est.est)+' points, '+pStr(est.p)+'). The effect is graded, not a threshold.');}
  else if(failK==='ct'){q.textContent='Does arriving with origin companions (co-transfer) help an entry take root?';
    var rows2=[];['coprimary','primary'].forEach(function(sp){['Screen','Held-out','MeSH'].forEach(function(f){var r=H.rows.filter(function(x){return x.fold===f&&x.spec===sp&&x.var==='CT';})[0];var vt=f2(r.irr)+' ['+f2(r.lo)+', '+f2(r.hi)+']  '+pStr(r.p);rows2.push({label:f+(sp==='primary'?' · primary':' · co-primary'),est:r.irr,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:'#6b7680',shape:'diamond',hollow:sp==='primary',valText:vt,tip:'<b>Co-transfer, '+f+'</b><br>'+(sp==='primary'?'Primary':'Co-primary')+' specification<br>IRR per SD '+vt+'<br>N = '+fmtInt(r.N)+', G = '+r.G});});});
    forest(box,rows2,{log:true,ref:1,xTitle:'Incidence-rate ratio per SD of co-transfer (log scale)',aria:'Co-transfer estimates'});
    var inc=rows2.filter(function(r){return r.lo<=1&&r.hi>=1;}).length;t.textContent=inc+' of '+rows2.length+' co-transfer intervals include 1. The composition of the entry matters, but the imported-package channel does not.';}
  else if(failK==='field'){q.textContent='Is the effect confined to some origin fields?';
    var rows3=K3.filter(function(x){return x.test==='K3_group';}).map(function(r){var sig=r.lo>1;var vt=f2(r.est)+' ['+f2(r.lo)+', '+f2(r.hi)+']  '+pStr(r.p);return {label:r.row==='other'?'Other fields':r.row==='CS'?'Computer Science':'Physics and Astronomy',est:r.est,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:sig?'var(--accent)':'#8a939c',hollow:!sig,valText:vt,tip:'<b>Origin field: '+esc(r.row)+'</b><br>Screen and Held-out pooled, co-primary FE<br>IRR per pooled SD '+vt+'<br>N = '+fmtInt(r.N)+', G = '+r.G};});
    forest(box,rows3,{log:true,ref:1,xTitle:'IRR per SD of host share (log scale)',aria:'Origin field estimates'});
    var w=K3.filter(function(x){return x.test==='K3_wald_equality';})[0],ph=K3.filter(function(x){return x.row==='Physics/Astro';})[0];
    t.textContent='Physics and Astronomy concepts are individually non-significant (IRR '+f2(ph.est)+', 95% CI '+f2(ph.lo)+' to '+f2(ph.hi)+'), yet the test that the three groups share one effect is null ('+pStr(w.p)+', label-permutation '+pStr(w.p_perm)+'). There is no detectable field boundary; the physics row is a weak cell, not a different effect.';}
  else{q.textContent='Did the pre-registered structural precursor, lower closure before sustained uptake, hold on the Held-out fold?';
    var rows4=RQ1.map(function(r){var col=r.decision==='CONFIRMED'?'var(--accent)':r.key==='constraint'?'var(--orange)':'#8a939c';var vt=sgn(r.es_ho,2)+' ['+sgn(r.es_ho_lo,2)+', '+sgn(r.es_ho_hi,2)+']'+(r.holm!=null?'  Holm p = '+r.holm.toFixed(3):'');
      return {label:r.label,est:r.es_ho,lo:r.es_ho_lo,hi:r.es_ho_hi,color:col,hollow:r.decision!=='CONFIRMED'&&r.key!=='constraint',valText:vt,tip:'<b>'+r.label+'</b><br>Held-out event study S '+sgn(r.es_ho,2)+', 95% CI '+sgn(r.es_ho_lo,2)+' to '+sgn(r.es_ho_hi,2)+'<br>Panel coefficient: Screen '+sgn(r.panel_scr,2)+', Held-out '+sgn(r.panel_ho,2)+(r.holm!=null?'<br>Holm p (panel) = '+r.holm.toFixed(3):'')+'<br>Decision: '+(r.decision==='CONFIRMED'?'confirmed':r.key==='constraint'?'positive, opposite to the brokerage prediction':'not confirmed')};});
    forest(box,rows4,{ref:0,xTitle:'Standardised mean difference, treated minus matched controls',aria:'Closure estimates on the Held-out fold',tickFmt:function(v){return String(v);}});
    var gc=RQ1[0],pn=RQ1[2],bc=RQ1[3];t.textContent='General closure fails (Holm p = '+gc.holm.toFixed(3)+'); only persistent-neighbour closure survives (panel '+sgn(pn.panel_ho,2)+', Holm p = '+pn.holm.toFixed(3)+'). Burt constraint is positive ('+sgn(bc.es_ho,2)+'), so the openness before emergence is not brokerage.';}}

/* misses */
(function(){var all=events.filter(function(e){return e.fold!==1||true;});var sorted=events.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.A-b.A;});var cut=sorted[Math.floor(0.9*sorted.length)].A;
  var miss=events.filter(function(e){return e.A>=cut&&e.Y===0;}),top=events.filter(function(e){return e.A>=cut;});
  document.getElementById('miss-text').textContent='Across all '+fmtInt(events.length)+' embedded events, the top tenth by host share starts at '+f3(cut)+'. Of those '+fmtInt(top.length)+' entries, '+fmtInt(miss.length)+' ('+(100*miss.length/top.length).toFixed(0)+'%) drew no newcomer paper at all. Host vocabulary shifts the odds; it does not decide single cases.';
  document.getElementById('miss-btn').addEventListener('click',function(){document.getElementById('br-fold').value='all';document.getElementById('br-out').value='none';document.getElementById('br-sort').value='share';document.getElementById('br-q').value='';brState.shown=25;drawBrowser(false);document.getElementById('v-browser').scrollIntoView({behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});document.getElementById('br-list').querySelector('button')&&document.getElementById('br-list').querySelector('button').focus({preventScroll:true});});})();

    tx(g,x+bw/2,y+36,s.k,{'text-anchor':'middle','font-size':W<560?13:14,'font-weight':600,fill:cur?'#fff':'#1b1f24','font-family':'var(--font)'});
    g.addEventListener('click',function(){go(i,true);});g.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();go(i,true);}});});}

Screen and Held-out are <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"devset\">development-set estimates</button>; the MeSH arm is the independent replication.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-headline\">\n      <p class=\"question\">Does the effect hold on every fold, and under the stricter model?</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <fieldset>\n          <legend>Model specification</legend>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Model specification\">\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"coprimary\" checked><span>Co-primary</span></label>\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"primary\"><span>Primary (strict FE)</span></label>\n          </div>\n        </fieldset>\n        <label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"show-ct\" checked> Show co-transfer</label>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n        <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Host-vocabulary share</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base);transform:rotate(45deg);width:11px;height:11px\"></i>Co-transfer</span>\n        <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:none;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink);height:0;width:18px;border-radius:0\"></i>No effect (IRR = 1)</span>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-headline\"></div>\n      <p class=\"small muted\" style=\"margin:6px 0 0\">Points are <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"irr\">IRR</button> per SD with 95% concept-clustered intervals on a log axis. Point at a mark for N, clusters and p.</p>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-headline\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ===================== HOW IT WORKS ===================== -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"method\" aria-labelledby=\"h-method\">\n  <p class=\"kicker\">How it works</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-method\">One real entry, from first paper to regression</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The stepper follows a single <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"entry\">host-entry event</button> recorded in the Screen fold: <em>Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering</em>, a quantum-physics concept, entering the OpenAlex subfield labelled Artificial Intelligence in 2011. Every value shown is the one the run stored for this event.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-stepper\">\n    <div id=\"pipeline\" class=\"pipeline\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Method stages\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stagepanel\">\n      <div>\n        <h3 id=\"stage-title\" tabindex=\"-1\"></h3>\n        <dl class=\"io\" id=\"stage-io\"></dl>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-stage\"></div>\n        <p class=\"small muted\" id=\"stage-cap\"></p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-prev\">Previous stage</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-next\">Next stage</button>\n      <span class=\"small muted\">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages when the stepper has focus.</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"sr\" id=\"stage-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig1_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Study design diagram in four panels: (a) the arXiv concept pool of 426 concepts split into Screen and Held-out folds plus 191 MeSH concepts, drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works; (b) a co-word network with three coloured communities; (c) an event-study schematic comparing a concept with sustained uptake against a flat control; (d) a concept moving from its origin subfield into a host subfield, with host-native and origin partner terms feeding a host-vocabulary share bar chart.\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"3840\" height=\"1648\">\n    <figcaption>Overview of the study design. (a) Data: an outcome-blind arXiv concept pool of 426 emerging scientific concepts, split into a screen fold (247) and a held-out fold (119), and an independent MeSH biomedical check population of 191 concepts. Both are drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works. (b) Co-word network: yearly co-word snapshots (25 snapshots, ~27k nodes, ~84k edges) with Leiden communities; the schematic shows three colour-coded communities. (c) RQ1, emergence precursors: a matched event study compares closure measures in the pre-onset window (shaded) between concepts showing sustained uptake (blue, rising after onset) and controls (grey, flat). (d) RQ2, host-entry grafting: a concept enters a non-origin host subfield (light blue → light green region). Its partner terms are either host-native (dark green) or from the origin vocabulary (light blue). The host-vocabulary share (orange) is the exposure in a pre-registered PPML regression with concept-clustered standard errors predicting 5-year newcomer uptake. The timelines and bars in (c) and (d) are schematic and carry no data values.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ===================== EXPLORE ===================== -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"explore\" aria-labelledby=\"h-explore\">\n  <p class=\"kicker\">Explore the evidence</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-explore\">The events behind the estimate</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">All three views below read the same embedded table of <span id=\"n-events-all\"></span> host-entry events, one row per event as the run stored it, with the out-of-sample predictions of a controls-only baseline and of the same model plus host share and co-transfer.</p>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-bins\">\n    <h3>Raw pattern by host share</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Before any model, do entries with more host vocabulary draw more newcomers?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"bins-fold\" class=\"lab\">Fold</label>\n      <select id=\"bins-fold\"><option value=\"0\">Screen</option><option value=\"1\">Held-out</option><option value=\"2\" selected>MeSH</option></select>\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend class=\"sr\">Quantity</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Quantity shown\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"binmetric\" value=\"mean\" checked><span>Mean newcomer papers</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"binmetric\" value=\"any\"><span>Share with any uptake</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"bins-legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-bins\"></div>\n    <p class=\"small muted\">Events are split into five equal-count groups by host-vocabulary share within the fold (Q1 lowest). Bars are computed in the page from the embedded rows, with no fixed effects; the prediction markers average the recorded per-event predictions.</p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-bins\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-browser\">\n    <h3>Event browser</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">What does one entry look like, and did adding host share move its prediction toward what happened?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"br-fold\" class=\"lab\">Fold</label>\n      <select id=\"br-fold\"><option value=\"all\">All folds</option><option value=\"0\" selected>Screen</option><option value=\"1\">Held-out</option><option value=\"2\">MeSH</option></select>\n      <label for=\"br-out\" class=\"lab\">Outcome</label>\n      <select id=\"br-out\"><option value=\"all\">Any outcome</option><option value=\"rooted\">Rooted</option><option value=\"some\">Some uptake, not rooted</option><option value=\"none\">No newcomer paper</option></select>\n      <label for=\"br-sort\" class=\"lab\">Sort</label>\n      <select id=\"br-sort\"><option value=\"share\">Host share, high to low</option><option value=\"y\">Newcomer papers, high to low</option><option value=\"gain\">Host share helped most</option><option value=\"loss\">Host share hurt most</option><option value=\"year\">Entry year, early first</option></select>\n id=\"br-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <ul class=\"itemlist\" id=\"br-list\" aria-label=\"Host-entry events\"></ul>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"br-more\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show 25 more</button>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"detail\" id=\"br-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small muted\">Screen and MeSH predictions are out-of-fold (grouped by concept, five folds). Held-out predictions come from the models fitted on Screen, applied to the Held-out events. \"Rooted\" is the paper's <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"rooted\">binary establishment</button> label.</p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-browser\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-cases\">\n    <h3>Four representative concepts</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Within one concept, is the entry that took root the one with the most host vocabulary?</p>\n    <div role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Case concept\" id=\"case-tabs\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--green)\"></i>Rooted entry</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#b8bfc7\"></i>Not rooted</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:none;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink);height:0;width:18px;border-radius:0\"></i>Mean of non-rooted entries</span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-cases\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-cases\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-margins\">\n    <h3>Does host vocabulary start uptake or enlarge it?</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Is the effect about whether any newcomer shows up, or how many?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Margin\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"margin\" value=\"ext\" checked><span>Extensive: any uptake</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"margin\" value=\"int\"><span>Intensive: how much</span></label>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-margins\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-margins\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig2_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Schematic co-word network: six dense clusters of coloured background terms joined by a few grey edges, with pool concepts drawn as black-ringed nodes in the gaps between clusters; wireless backhaul, EPR steering and holographic QCD are labelled.\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"3312\" height=\"2480\">\n    <figcaption>Schematic co-word network snapshot (2012, three-year window). Nodes are concept-keyword terms and grey edges are association-strength weighted co-occurrences; node fill colour marks Leiden community membership, and larger circles are high-degree hub terms. Background terms (plain nodes) form dense communities that are joined by only a few inter-community edges. Pool concepts (bold black rings) sit on the periphery of communities, mostly in the gaps between two of them, where they act as bridge or connector nodes; three are labelled as examples (wireless backhaul, EPR steering, holographic QCD). The full network comprises approximately 27,000 nodes and 84,000 edges; the panel is an illustrative rendering of its high-degree core for readability.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ===================== TRY IT ===================== -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n  <p class=\"kicker\">Try it</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Draw your own line between host-leaning and foreign entries</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The paper uses host share as a continuous exposure because only 1.1% of partner tags have a host share above 50%. Here you can impose a cut-off yourself. The page splits the recorded events at your threshold and recomputes the outcome rates on each side. This is a raw comparison across concepts, so it mixes the host effect with concept and field differences that the regression absorbs.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-try\">\n    <p class=\"question\">If we call an entry \"host-leaning\" above a threshold, how different are the two groups?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"thr\" class=\"lab\">Host-share threshold</label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"thr\" min=\"0.005\" max=\"0.2\" step=\"0.001\" value=\"0.043\" aria-describedby=\"thr-note\">\n      <output id=\"thr-out\" for=\"thr\"></output>\n      <label for=\"try-fold\" class=\"lab\">Fold</label>\n      <select id=\"try-fold\"><option value=\"0\">Screen</option><option value=\"1\">Held-out</option><option value=\"2\">MeSH</option></select>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Outcome\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"tryout\" value=\"any\" checked><span>Any newcomer paper</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"tryout\" value=\"rooted\"><span>Rooted</span></label>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small muted\" id=\"thr-note\">The default, 0.043, is the mean host share of Screen entries reported in the paper.</p>\n    <div class=\"grid2\" style=\"grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:18px\">\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-try\"></div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-sweep\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-try\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ===================== FAILS ===================== -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n  <p class=\"kicker\">Where it fails</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">The rows that did not hold</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">A result is only as good as its failures are visible. Each tab below shows one place where the evidence is null, reversed or underpowered, drawn from the run's recorded estimates.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-fails\">\n    <div role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Failure view\" id=\"fail-tabs\">\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"ft-ladder\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"c-fail\" data-k=\"ladder\">Uptake threshold</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"ft-ct\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"c-fail\" data-k=\"ct\" tabindex=\"-1\">Co-transfer</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"ft-field\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"c-fail\" data-k=\"field\" tabindex=\"-1\">Origin field</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"ft-rq1\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"c-fail\" data-k=\"rq1\" tabindex=\"-1\">Closure before emergence</button>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"question\" id=\"fail-q\"></p>\n    <div class=\"controls\" id=\"fail-sub\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-fail\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"ft-ladder\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-fail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"view\">\n    <h3>Entries the gradient does not explain</h3>\n    <p class=\"question\">Which entries had plenty of host vocabulary and still drew no newcomer?</p>\n    <p id=\"miss-text\" class=\"measure\"></p>\n    <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"miss-btn\">Open these entries in the event browser</button>\n  </div>\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:28px\">What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"limits measure\">\n    <li><strong>The main-arm folds are development sets.</strong> Event counts, population sizes and gating decisions were computed on both Screen and Held-out before grafting outcomes were read. The independent evidence is the MeSH replication.</li>\n    <li><strong>The population is narrow.</strong> The pool is dominated by physics, physical-sciences and computer-science concepts from arXiv, and MeSH covers biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries only. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n    <li><strong>The strictest model is underpowered.</strong> With concept-by-year and host-by-year fixed effects the Held-out fold keeps 250 of 972 events in 30 clusters and is inconclusive.</li>\n    <li><strong>Most entries are a single paper.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve one entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48), but the Held-out fold alone is underpowered for this test.</li>\n    <li><strong>Cluster-robust p-values run hot.</strong> The estimator rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles in simulation against a 5% target; the wild-cluster bootstrap (Held-out p = 0.012) and permutation tests (p = 0.026) are the safer reading.</li>\n    <li><strong>Host-specificity rests on a weak leg.</strong> The Balassa-index lift has a within-fixed-effect correlation of 0.997 with the log of the continuous share, so it confirms the share rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n    <li><strong>The adopter result is Screen-only.</strong> Adopters are enriched for prior exposure to entry partners (OR 3.09; prevalence 0.79 vs. 0.61), but the design cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n    <li><strong>The Held-out closure test borrows controls.</strong> 17 of 25 unique controls come from the Screen fold's never-treated pool, and the MeSH closure result is null under the primary label.</li>\n  </ul>\n</section>\n</div>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"sources\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <h2>Links, sources and terms</h2>\n    <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin:12px 0 22px\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_desxWCcMY1R1/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_desxWCcMY1R1/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_desxWCcMY1R1\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n    <h3>Data provenance</h3>\n    <p class=\"measure small muted\">Each dataset is embedded in this file as a JSON script element, produced by a script that reads the run's output files.  for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const a=ts[i][1],b=ts[j][1];const w=Math.min(a.right,b.right)-Math.max(a.left,b.left),h=Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(a.top,b.top);if(w>1&&h>1)out.push([si,ts[i][0],ts[j][0]]);}});return out;}"""

        pg.locator('#show-ct').click(); pg.locator('label:has(input[name=spec][value=coprimary])').click()
        m=pg.locator('#c-headline .mark').nth(0)
        if touch: m.tap()
        else: m.hover()
        check(pg.locator('#tip').is_visible() and 'N = 1,544' in pg.locator('#tip').inner_text(),'mark tooltip: '+pg.locator('#tip').inner_text().replace('\n',' | ')[:100])
        if w==1440: pg.screenshot(path='shots/op_headline_tip.png')
        # term tooltip survives click
        term=pg.locator('#finding .term').first
        if touch: term.tap()
        else: term.click()
        pg.wait_for_timeout(150)
        check(pg.locator('#termtip').is_visible(),'term tooltip visible after click/tap: '+pg.locator('#termtip').inner_text()[:60])
        if w==1440: pg.screenshot(path='shots/op_term.png')
        pg.keyboard.press('Escape'); check(not pg.locator('#termtip').is_visible(),'Escape closes term')
        term.click() if not touch else term.tap(); pg.locator('h1').click(); check(not pg.locator('#termtip').is_visible(),'click elsewhere closes term')
        # stepper
        titles=[T(pg,'stage-title')]
        for i in range(5):
            pg.locator('#step-next').click(); titles.append(T(pg,'stage-title'))
            if w==1440: pg.locator('#v-stepper').screenshot(path=f'shots/op_stage{i+2}.png')
        check(len(set(titles))==6,'6 stages: '+' / '.join(titles))
        check(pg.locator('#step-next').is_disabled(),'next disabled at end')
        check(pg.locator('#pipeline g[aria-current=step]').count()==1,'aria-current on one marker')
        check('Stage 6 of 6' in pg.locator('#stage-live').text_content(),'live region: '+pg.locator('#stage-live').text_content())
        pg.locator('#pipeline g[role=button]').nth(2).click(); check(T(pg,'stage-title').startswith('3.'),'marker click -> '+T(pg,'stage-title'))
        pg.keyboard.press('ArrowRight'); check(T(pg,'stage-title').startswith('4.'),'ArrowRight -> '+T(pg,'stage-title'))
        pg.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft'); pg.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft'); pg.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft'); pg.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft')
        check(T(pg,'stage-title').startswith('1.') and pg.locator('#step-prev').is_disabled(),'back to stage 1, prev disabled')
        ov=pg.evaluate(OVL); check(not ov, f'no overlap after stepper {ov[:5]}')
        # bins
        t0=T(pg,'t-bins'); pg.select_option('#bins-fold','0'); t1=T(pg,'t-bins'); pg.locator('label:has(input[name=binmetric][value=any])').click(); t2=T(pg,'t-bins')
        check(t0!=t1!=t2,'bins takeaway changes: '+t2[:90])
        # browser
        pg.fill('#br-q',''); pg.select_option('#br-fold','2'); pg.select_option('#br-sort','y'); c=T(pg,'br-count'); check('2,249' in c,'MeSH count: '+c)
        pg.locator('#br-list button').nth(2).click(); d=pg.locator('#br-detail h4').first.inner_text(); tb=T(pg,'t-browser'); check(pg.locator('#br-list button[aria-pressed=true]').count()==1,'selected item: '+d+' | '+tb[:80])
        pg.select_option('#br-out','none'); check('No newcomer' not in T(pg,'br-count'),'outcome filter: '+T(pg,'br-count'))
        pg.locator('#br-more').click(); check(pg.locator('#br-list li').count()==50,'show more -> %d rows'%pg.locator('#br-list li').count())
        pg.fill('#br-q','holographic'); pg.select_option('#br-fold','all'); pg.select_option('#br-out','all'); check(pg.locator('#br-list li').count()>0,'search holographic: '+T(pg,'br-count'))
        if w==1440: pg.locator('#v-browser').screenshot(path='shots/op_browser.png')
        # cases
        outs=[]
        for i in range(4):
            pg.locator('#case-tabs [role=tab]').nth(i).click(); outs.append(T(pg,'t-cases'))
            if w==1440 and i in (1,3): pg.locator('#v-cases').screenshot(path=f'shots/op_case{i}.png')
        for o in outs: print('    case:',o)
        pg.locator('#case-tabs [role=tab]').nth(0).focus(); pg.keyboard.press('ArrowRight'); check(pg.locator('#case-tab-1').get_attribute('aria-selected')=='true','case tabs arrow key')
        # margins
        pg.locator('label:has(input[name=margin][value=int])').click(); check('1.183' in T(pg,'t-margins'),'intensive: '+T(pg,'t-margins')[:100])
        # try
        v0=T(pg,'thr-out'); t0=T(pg,'t-try'); pg.locator('#thr').focus()
        for _ in range(20): pg.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
        v1=T(pg,'thr-out'); t1=T(pg,'t-try'); check(v0!=v1 and t0!=t1,f'slider {v0}->{v1}: '+t1[:90])
        pg.select_option('#try-fold','2'); pg.locator('label:has(input[name=tryout][value=rooted])').click(); check(T(pg,'t-try')!=t1,'try fold/outcome: '+T(pg,'t-try')[:90])
        if w==1440: pg.locator('#v-try').screenshot(path='shots/op_try.png')
        # fails
        for k in ('ct','field','rq1','ladder'):
            pg.locator(f'#fail-tabs [data-k={k}]').click(); print('    fail',k,':',T(pg,'t-fail')[:140])
            if w==1440: pg.locator('#v-fails').screenshot(path=f'shots/op_fail_{k}.png')
            ov=pg.evaluate(OVL); check(not ov, f'no overlap fail {k} {ov[:5]}')
        pg.locator('label:has(input[name=ladfold][value=MESH])').click(); print('    ladder mesh:',T(pg,'t-fail')[:120])
        # misses
        print('    miss:',T(pg,'miss-text'))
        pg.locator('#miss-btn').click(); pg.wait_for_timeout(300); check(pg.locator('#br-out').input_value()=='none','miss button sets browser filter: '+T(pg,'br-count'))
        ov=pg.evaluate(OVL); check(not ov, f'no overlap end {ov[:5]}')
        sw=pg.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth'); check(sw<=w,f'no horizontal scroll ({sw})')
        check(not msgs,'console clean %s'%msgs)
        if w==390: pg.screenshot(path='shots/op_390_full.png',full_page=True)
        ctx.close()
    b.close()
EOF

I've built `interactive.html` and linked it from `index.html`. In a headless browser at 390, 1280 and 1440 px, every control worked with real clicks. There were no console errors, no sideways scrolling and no overlapping chart labels, and a term definition stays open after it is clicked or tapped.

**What the page shows** (every chart is drawn from the run's own output files, embedded as 8 JSON elements):
- **The finding:** a chart of the effect on each fold (Screen, Held-out, MeSH and the pooled estimate). You can switch between the co-primary and the strict model and show or hide co-transfer. The headline number is +23% on MeSH (IRR 1.23, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.36).
- **How it works:** a six-stage walkthrough of one real event, EPR steering entering Artificial Intelligence in 2011. It uses the values the run stored: host share 0.142 against a mean of 0.043, 37 newcomer papers, and predictions of 18.34 without host share and 21.62 with it.
- **Explore:** four views:
  - uptake by host-share fifth;
  - a browser over all 5,086 recorded entry events, with filters, search and sort, where each event shows its inputs, what happened, and the prediction with and without host share;
  - the four case concepts;
  - the split between whether uptake starts and how large it gets.
- **Try it:** a slider for a host-share cut-off that recomputes outcome rates on each side live. It is labelled as a raw comparison with no fixed effects.
- **Where it fails:** tabs for the stricter uptake thresholds, co-transfer, origin field and the closure results. A button opens the high-share entries that drew no newcomers in the browser. The paper's limitations follow.
- **Footer:** all links, a table naming the source file behind each view, a glossary of 18 terms, and the citation.

I show two of the paper's figures, the design diagram and the network schematic, because neither has data behind it.

**Things you should know:**
- **Burt constraint rounding:** the source value is 0.1046. The paper rounded it to 0.105 and then to 0.11, so rounding it once would print 0.10. The closure view applies the same two-step rounding, which reproduces every closure number in the paper.
- **Pooled estimate:** the source file for "pooled 1.26" combines the Screen and MeSH estimates, but the paper labels it "All three" folds. The page follows the paper's label.
- **Held-out predictions:** these come from models fitted on the Screen fold. The Screen and MeSH predictions are out-of-fold. The page says this under the browser.
- **Author line:** the paper has none, so the header says so rather than inventing one.
- **No existing file edited beyond `index.html`:** the only change there is the "Explore the interactive demo" link, added after the paper link in both the hero and the footer. `README.md` and `.aii/manifest.yaml` are untouched; the new file is text, so it needs no manifest entry. The build scripts and screenshots are in the scratchpad, outside the published folder.

The structured result is in `./.terminal_claude_agent_struct_out.json`.
